title: ph generate all --extract writes a spec document for every existing module instead of generating code
content:
## The generator run backwards

Normally codegen flows spec → code. `--extract` / `-x` inverts it: instead of generating code the command reads the existing project and writes a **spec document** for each module it finds. The CLI describes it as a "one-shot migration to documents-as-source-of-truth" — the way a hand-written pre-Vetra project becomes a project Vetra Studio can drive.

```bash
ph generate all --extract        # every module in the project
ph generate editor --extract     # just the editors
ph generate processor -x         # short form
```

`startGenerateAll` builds a ts-morph project over the source tree, calls `extractAllDocuments(project)`, and saves each of `documentModels`, `editors`, `processors`, `subgraphs` and `apps` — then **returns before `generateAll` runs**. Extract and generate are mutually exclusive within one invocation; nothing is overwritten in `document-models/` or `editors/`.

## Where the specs land

`saveSpec` writes to a deterministic path: `<projectDir>/specs/<subdir>/<kebab-name>.<ext>.phd`, with one subdirectory per kind — `specs/document-models/`, `specs/editors/`, `specs/processors/`, `specs/subgraphs/`, `specs/apps/`. Directories are created as needed, the name is kebab-cased from the document header (falling back to `untitled`), and the extension comes from each document type's own utils. Every written path is echoed as `Wrote <path>`.

The per-module `--extract` flags name their target explicitly, so the mapping is documented on each subcommand: `powerhouse/document-model` specs to `specs/document-models/`, `powerhouse/document-editor` to `specs/editors/`, `powerhouse/app` to `specs/apps/`, `powerhouse/processor` to `specs/processors/`, `powerhouse/subgraph` to `specs/subgraphs/`.

The point of the round trip: once the specs exist, they are ordinary Powerhouse documents. Drop them into the Vetra drive and `ph vetra --watch` picks up changes to them and regenerates the code — the project stops being source-first and becomes specification-driven, without a rewrite.

_Source: `clis/ph-cli/src/commands/generate-all.ts`, `clis/ph-cli/src/services/generate-all.ts`, `packages/vetra/codegen/specs.ts`, Powerhouse v6.2.2-dev.45._
description: A one-shot migration to documents-as-source-of-truth: it emits a spec per document model, editor, app, processor and subgraph into specs/<kind>/ and generates nothing.
